_how_to: BC Hydro peak events, edited by hand. One object per event. date = BC calendar day (YYYY-MM-DD). start/end = BC clock time (America/Vancouver, permanent UTC-7 from Nov 2026), 24-hour HH:MM on the hour; end is exclusive and may be 24:00. Example: start 17:00, end 21:00 covers 5-9 p.m. = hour-beginning 17,18,19,20 = hour-ending HE18,HE19,HE20,HE21 (BC Hydro's load files and the site's hourly data use these hours). source = where the event notice came from; note = free text. Keep the list in any order; the next data run picks up changes.

events.note: First Peak Saver event: 'reduce your electricity use by 20% between 5 p.m. and 9 p.m.'
